research_question: Can prior-only volume-synchronized buckets distinguish toxic information-driven price discovery from absorbed order flow strongly enough for cost-positive multi-hour day trades?

sources: VPIN and volume-synchronized probability of informed trading
volume-time bars used by discretionary and systematic traders
reused: sample market state in equal expected quote-volume buckets rather than fixed time
rolling absolute signed-flow imbalance estimates toxicity
price response per unit toxicity separates information delivery from absorption
entry waits for a separately completed time-bar transition

scenario.context: a volume bucket closes after accumulating a target derived only from the prior seven-day median five-minute quote volume

state.TOXIC_FLOW_PRICE_DISCOVERY: high prior-standardized VPIN, strong signed imbalance, same-direction bucket return and high price impact
state.ABSORBED_TOXIC_FLOW_REVERSAL: high prior-standardized VPIN and signed imbalance but low or opposite price response
state.UNRESOLVED: all other volume buckets are no-trade

scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar moves in the route direction with directional body and taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: outside the toxic bucket extreme plus ten percent of prior bucket ATR
scenario.management: continuation trails completed thirty-minute closes; reversal uses midpoint target; both stop first and cap at four hours
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; choose the largest toxicity-response quality

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: bucket target and all toxicity thresholds use only rows completed before the bucket; confirmation follows bucket completion

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed toxicity route positive in every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune volume target, VPIN, impact, absorption, confirmation or stop rules after evaluation.
